summary: Navitas Semiconductor Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the issuance of 3,280,666 shares of Class A common stock in satisfaction of Triggering Event III under its 2021 Business Combination Agreement. This final earnout issuance completes all contingent earnout obligations tied to price targets, aggregating 9,841,948 shares issued. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. This is a routine post-combination earnout fulfillment, not a special situation.
